description: Append existing global ring attack and decay after the unchanged 31-lane prefix. All 21 earlier numerical and capability contracts remain unchanged.

host_automation_ring_times.keys: Original 31 in original order, then P_ringAttack at lane 31 and P_ringDecay at lane 32.
host_automation_ring_times.authority: Global ring times retain existing PANEL/factory/MEMORY independence, ranges and skewed conversions. The existing envelope latches times only when a new ring trigger occurs while ringKeyDown is false; updating the global controls does not reshape an already running envelope.
host_automation_ring_times.timing: Modern VST3 normalized interpolation is published through existing physical conversion before MIDI at the same sample, so a qualifying trigger latches that sample's value. No-queue and Legacy/PURE final-point behavior unchanged. AU not expanded.
host_automation_ring_times.verification: Bounded actual-module Linux float32 finite attack-only and decay-only queues; same-offset onset and partition/reference witnesses. Late-only controls explicitly retain initial values through every initial engine trigger and test PCM inertness only during a window without a later fresh trigger. Existing numeric tolerances unchanged; source/host/module provenance and frozen pre-feature 31-lane PCM compatibility required. No live-ADSR, malformed-input, GUI, DAW, hardware or CPU claim.
